info.title: Outstand Gateway API
info.description: Zeptly's gateway to Outstand. Implements Gateway Contract v1 (/v1/gateway, /v1/capabilities, /v1/connections) and the capability contracts Outstand backs: Social Publishing v1 (/v1/social/publishing), Social Scheduling v1, Social Analytics (basic) v1 (/v1/social/analytics) and Social Direct Messages v1 (/v1/social/direct-messages). Provider identifiers never appear in responses. Authenticated with ZS1-HMAC-SHA256 service signatures (see docs/SECURITY.md).

zeptlyServiceSignature.name: X-Zeptly-Signature
zeptlyServiceSignature.description: ZS1-HMAC-SHA256 signature. Also requires X-Zeptly-Caller, X-Zeptly-Timestamp and (workspace routes) X-Zeptly-Workspace-Id. See docs/SECURITY.md.
